# graviteeam_group (Resource)

Manages a Gravitee AM Group

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graviteeam_group" "example" {
  domain_id   = graviteeam_domain.example.id
  name        = "Administrators"
  description = "Admin group"
  roles       = [graviteeam_role.example.id]
  members     = [graviteeam_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (String) The ID of the domain this group belongs to
- `name` (String) The name of the group

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the group
- `members` (List of String) List of user IDs that are members of this group
- `roles` (List of String) List of role IDs assigned to this group

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the group
